title: SproutRAG：面向长文档RAG的注意力引导树搜索与渐进嵌入
summary: SproutRAG提出一种注意力引导的分层RAG框架，通过将句子级块组织成渐进式语义单元并构建二叉分块树，实现多粒度检索。无需额外LLM调用或压缩摘要，在科学、法律和开放域基准上平均信息效率提升6.1%。
summary_en: SproutRAG presents an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that organizes sentence-level chunks into progressively larger semantic units via a binary chunking tree, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without extra LLM calls or lossy summarization, achieving 6.1% average information efficiency improvement.
